start_here: Say to your AI: "Inspect the Claude Code hooks my account set on my computer studio-mac", with {"computer_id": "studio-mac", "harness": "claude-code", "action": "inspect"}. It runs tool:manage-harness on that computer and answers what is set and what would change.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of yours: it reads and changes the hook settings of one AI app on one computer you own.
instructions: 1. Name the computer (its computer_id) and the AI app (harness: claude-code or codex).
2. Run it first with "action": "inspect" and read the report, including each hook's definition_hash.

3. Run it with "action": "apply" to set the account's hooks, or "remove" to take them out; for Codex, apply with trust_hooks true only after reviewing the four definition hashes the inspect report gave, passed as reviewed_definition_hashes.
